why: B5 showed the per-leg slip RATIO reward rewards standing still: with forward speed near zero the ratio explodes, yet the summed penalty is still smaller than the cost of moving, so the policy parked itself. This round changes only the training signal, never the acceptance metric.

reward_changes.slip_term: from hinge on r_i = v_i / max(|forward|, 0.05) to hinge on ABSOLUTE foot speed: 2.0 * sum_i max(0, v_i - 0.5 * max(|forward|, v_target))^2, so the allowance scales with the COMMANDED speed and standing cannot game it
reward_changes.progress_term: clip(forward / v_target, -1, 1.5) doubled while forward < 0.5 * v_target, so failing to make progress costs more than it did

unchanged: acceptance thresholds and the whole frozen verifier definition
evaluation: each run is evaluated with the 1 s assist + 3 s autonomous protocol in its own training condition, and the no-grip run is also evaluated with grip off; per-leg material slip is computed with the frozen definition
decision_rule: report every number; if slip stays above 0.5 the negative result stands and no weight, cap, allowance factor or threshold is changed afterwards
labelling: grip runs are derived-channel results; the frozen-body status remains unaccepted regardless of outcome
